verdict.rationale: HubSpot's developer docs say users can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting real HubSpot data. That is a first-party, non-production test environment, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: details on how test accounts are provisioned and seeded with data, any evidence that AI agents or the MCP servers can be pointed at test accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration, and coverage of production-like sandbox features such as config syncing from production.
